title: Cultural Resources Commission short on members
summary: As of August 2026, the county's boards and commissions liaison believes no one is on the applicant list for the Cultural Resources Commission. The commission has a heavy role in the Lahaina historic district rebuild. It has struggled with vacancies, with only five of nine seats filled in 2025 and many meetings missing quorum.

timeline.text: The county's boards and commissions liaison said she thinks no one is on the applicant list for this commission right now.
The meeting ended for lack of a quorum before the director's report.
